questions.question_english: In which of the following exceptional circumstances can an authority bypass GeM for procuring common-use goods?
options_english: When goods are available on GeM but a local vendor offers a significant promotional cash discount.
When the buyer's procurement committee finds that the online e-marketplace platform is complex to navigate.
When a certificate of non-availability (GeM Availability Report) is generated on the portal.
When the total procurement proposal value falls below the minimal threshold of Rs. 1,000 per occasion.
questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 149 of GFR 2017 and Ministry of Finance (Department of Expenditure) guidelines, procuring common-use goods and services available on GeM through open-market channels outside GeM is strictly prohibited. Bypassing GeM is legally permissible only when the specific required item or service is genuinely not available on GeM, or when the available products do not meet mandatory technical specifications. In such situations, the procuring entity must perform a search on the GeM portal and generate a system-certified 'GeM Availability Report' (Certificate of Non-Availability) with a unique GeM AR ID. Only after recording this certificate on file can the department proceed to procure through alternative routes such as Rule 154 (Direct Purchase without Quotation) or Rule 155 (Local Purchase Committee).
questions.explanation_hindi: GFR 2017 के नियम 149 और वित्त मंत्रालय (व्यय विभाग) के दिशा-निर्देशों के अनुसार, GeM पर उपलब्ध सामान्य उपयोग की वस्तुओं और सेवाओं को GeM के बाहर खुले बाजार से खरीदना पूरी तरह से प्रतिबंधित है। GeM को छोड़कर बाह्य माध्यमों से खरीद करने की अनुमति केवल तभी है जब वांछित वस्तु या सेवा GeM पोर्टल पर उपलब्ध न हो। इस असाधारण परिस्थिति में, क्रेता को पोर्टल पर सर्च करके आधिकारिक 'GeM उपलब्धता रिपोर्ट' (गैर-उपलब्धता प्रमाण पत्र / GeM Availability Report) उत्पन्न करनी होती है, जिसका एक विशिष्ट आईडी नंबर होता है। इस प्रमाण पत्र को फाइल में दर्ज करने के बाद ही विभाग GFR नियम 154 या 155 के तहत बाह्य खरीद प्रक्रिया प्रारंभ कर सकता है।

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).

Assertion (A): No authority should exercise its powers of sanctioning expenditure to pass an order which will be directly or indirectly to its own advantage.
Reason (R): The principles of financial propriety strictly prohibit conflict of interest in the management and sanction of public funds.

In light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is true but (R) is false
(A) is false but (R) is true
questions.explanation_english:
Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, and (R) correctly explains (A).

1. Legal Basis: Rule 21(iv) of GFR 2017 states: "No authority should exercise its powers of sanctioning expenditure or to pass an order which will be directly or indirectly to its own advantage."
2. Conflict of Interest Doctrine: Public money is held in fiduciary trust. An authority cannot act as both the judge/sanctioning officer and the beneficiary of public expenditure. If a sanction confers personal financial benefit (e.g., sanctioning rent of one's own private building for a school, sanctioning personal allowances beyond entitlements), an explicit conflict of interest arises. Reason (R) directly provides the core administrative and ethical rationale underpinning Assertion (A).
questions.explanation_hindi:
अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, तथा (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या प्रस्तुत करता है।

1. वैधानिक आधार: GFR 2017 का नियम 21(iv) निर्धारित करता है: "किसी भी प्राधिकारी को व्यय स्वीकृत करने की अपनी शक्तियों का प्रयोग ऐसा कोई आदेश पारित करने के लिए नहीं करना चाहिए जो प्रत्यक्ष या अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से उसके अपने लाभ के लिए हो।"
2. हितों के टकराव का सिद्धांत: सार्वजनिक धन एक न्यास (ट्रस्ट) के रूप में धारित होता है। कोई भी सरकारी अधिकारी एक ही समय में व्यय स्वीकृत करने वाला प्राधिकारी और उसका लाभार्थी दोनों नहीं बन सकता। यदि किसी स्वीकृति से अधिकारी को कोई व्यक्तिगत वित्तीय लाभ पहुंचता है (जैसे अपने निजी भवन को विद्यालय हेतु किराए पर लेना या निर्धारित सीमा से अधिक भत्ते स्वीकृत करना), तो यह हितों का टकराव उत्पन्न करता है। अतः कारण (R) अभिकथन (A) की सटीक व्याख्या करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: correct explanation of (A) Financial propriety strictly mandates that no public authority may exercise its administrative or financial powers to sanction any expenditure that yields a direct or indirect personal benefit to itself. Eliminating conflicts of interest is essential for maintaining integrity in public administration, ensuring that every financial decision remains unbiased, objective, transparent, and driven strictly by official necessity and public benefit.

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): For the selection of consultants, the Quality and Cost Based Selection (QCBS) method is frequently used.
Reason (R): The QCBS method allows the procuring entity to evaluate bids based only on the lowest cost, ignoring the technical competence of the consultant.
In light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is true but (R) is false
(A) is false but (R) is true
questions.explanation_english:
Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false:
- Assertion (A) is true: Under Rule 192 of GFR 2017, Quality and Cost Based Selection (QCBS) is the standard and most widely utilized method for selecting consultants, especially when the quality of the assignment is paramount and balanced against cost.
- Reason (R) is false: QCBS does NOT evaluate bids based solely on lowest cost, nor does it ignore technical competence. On the contrary, under QCBS, proposals are evaluated based on combined technical and financial scores with predetermined weightages (typically 80% for technical quality and 20% for cost, or 70:30). The bidder obtaining the highest combined score is awarded the contract. Evaluating bids solely on lowest financial cost after minimal qualification is the 'Least Cost System' (LCS) under Rule 193, not QCBS.
Therefore, (A) is true but (R) is false.
questions.explanation_hindi:
अभिकथन (A) सही है, परंतु कारण (R) गलत है:
- अभिकथन (A) सही है: GFR 2017 के नियम 192 के तहत, गुणवत्ता और लागत आधारित चयन (QCBS) परामर्श सेवाओं के चयन के लिए सर्वाधिक उपयोग की जाने वाली प्रणाली है, जहाँ बौद्धिक आउटपुट की गुणवत्ता और वित्तीय लागत दोनों का संतुलित मूल्यांकन किया जाता है।
- कारण (R) गलत है: QCBS में तकनीकी योग्यता की अनदेखी नहीं की जाती और न ही चयन केवल न्यूनतम लागत के आधार पर होता है। इसके विपरीत, QCBS में तकनीकी प्रस्ताव और वित्तीय प्रस्ताव दोनों का मूल्यांकन पूर्व-निर्धारित भारांक (जैसे 80% तकनीकी और 20% वित्तीय) देकर किया जाता है। दोनों को मिलाकर सर्वाधिक संयुक्त अंक (highest combined score) प्राप्त करने वाले बोलीदाता को अनुबंध दिया जाता है। न्यूनतम लागत पर चयन की प्रणाली 'न्यूनतम लागत प्रणाली' (LCS - नियम 193) कहलाती है। अतः (A) सही है लेकिन (R) गलत है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) (A) is true but (R) is false

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Quality and Cost Based Selection is a widely utilized methodology for evaluating consulting proposals. However, it does not evaluate bids based solely on cost. Instead, it assigns weightage to both technical competence and financial proposals, balancing technical capability with competitive pricing. This ensures high-quality intellectual output while maintaining reasonable expenditure controls.

questions.question_english: Which of the following advances was abolished for Central Government employees as a permanent standing provision following the implementation of the 7th Central Pay Commission recommendations?
options_english: Personal Computer Advance
Festival Advance
Travelling Allowance (TA) Advance on Tour
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) Advance
questions.explanation_english:
Following the acceptance of the recommendations of the 7th Central Pay Commission (7th CPC) by the Government of India (Department of Expenditure OM No. 12(1)/E.II(A)/2016 dated October 7, 2016):
1. Abolished Advances: Numerous minor interest-free and interest-bearing advances were abolished to rationalize accounting procedures and eliminate unnecessary paperwork. These abolished advances included Festival Advance, Natural Calamity Advance, Warm Clothing Advance, Advance of Pay on Transfer, and Bicycle Advance.
2. Retained Advances: Only three categories of advances were retained:
   - House Building Advance (HBA) - Interest-bearing
   - Personal Computer Advance (PCA) - Interest-bearing
   - Operational duty advances such as TA/DA advance on tour/transfer, LTC advance, and medical advance.
(Note: While temporary interest-free schemes like the Special Festival Advance Scheme were intermittently launched as economic relief packages via prepaid RuPay cards during the pandemic, Festival Advance was formally abolished as a regular standing rule).
Therefore, Festival Advance was abolished.
questions.explanation_hindi:
भारत सरकार द्वारा 7वें केंद्रीय वेतन आयोग (7th CPC) की सिफारिशों को स्वीकार करने के बाद (व्यय विभाग के कार्यालय ज्ञापन सं. 12(1)/E.II(A)/2016 दिनांक 7 अक्टूबर 2016 द्वारा):

2. बरकरार रखे गए अग्रिम: केवल तीन श्रेणियों के अग्रिमों को जारी रखा गया:

questions.question_english:
Consider the following conditions precedent governing the write-off of a loss of public money or stores under GFR:
I. The loss does not disclose a defect in rules or procedures requiring amendment.
II. There has not been any serious negligence on the part of any government servant.
III. The loss must always be compensated by the Ministry of Finance.
IV. Adequate administrative action has been taken against the person responsible (if applicable).
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I, II and IV only
II, III and IV only
I, III and IV only
I, II, III and IV
questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 37 of GFR 2017 and the Delegation of Financial Powers Rules (DFPR), an authority competent to sanction the write-off of losses of public money, revenue, or stores must satisfy itself regarding essential conditions precedent: (I) The loss does not reveal any systemic defect or ambiguity in the existing rules or procedures whose amendment requires the orders of higher authority or the Ministry of Finance; (II) The loss was not caused by culpable or serious negligence on the part of any individual government servant calling for disciplinary action or personal recovery; and (IV) Where an employee was partially at fault, adequate departmental/disciplinary action has been instituted and recovery pursued. Statement III is incorrect because the Ministry of Finance does not provide budgetary reimbursement or direct compensation for losses incurred by departments; a write-off is merely a formal accounting adjustment regularizing the removal of irrecoverable balances from official ledgers. Hence, statements I, II, and IV are correct.
questions.explanation_hindi: जीएफआर 2017 के नियम 37 तथा वित्तीय शक्तियों के प्रत्यायोजन नियम (DFPR) के तहत सार्वजनिक धन या सामान की हानि को बट्टे खाते में डालने (Write-off) से पूर्व सक्षम प्राधिकारी को अनिवार्य पूर्व-शर्तों की संतुष्टि करनी होती है: (I) हानि से नियमों या प्रक्रियाओं में ऐसी किसी गंभीर कमी का पता न चलता हो जिसके संशोधन हेतु उच्चाधिकारी या वित्त मंत्रालय के आदेश की आवश्यकता हो; (II) किसी सरकारी सेवक की गंभीर या आपराधिक लापरवाही न रही हो जिसके लिए व्यक्तिगत वसूली या अनुशासनात्मक दंड आवश्यक हो; तथा (IV) जहां कोई कर्मचारी उत्तरदायी था, वहां उचित अनुशासनात्मक कार्रवाई की गई हो और वसूली के प्रयास किए गए हों। कथन III गलत है क्योंकि वित्त मंत्रालय विभागीय हानियों की कोई बजटीय प्रतिपूर्ति या नकद मुआवजा प्रदान नहीं करता; बट्टे खाते में डालना केवल एक वैधानिक लेखा समायोजन (accounting adjustment) है जिसके माध्यम से अप्राप्य संपत्ति को सरकारी बही-खातों से हटाया जाता है। अतः कथन I, II और IV सही हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (a) I, II and IV

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Writing off a financial loss requires confirming that the loss does not reveal systemic rule defects needing amendment and that serious employee negligence was absent. Furthermore, appropriate administrative action must be taken against responsible individuals. The Ministry of Finance does not automatically compensate departmental losses, as write-offs represent formal accounting adjustments.

questions.question_english: Under the General Financial Rules (GFR) 2017, which authority is legally empowered to sanction material variations, amendments, or scope modifications in an already executed contract?
options_english: The Junior Engineer, Site Supervisor, or field technical official permanently stationed at the work site.
Only the competent authority that originally sanctioned/approved the contract (or a higher authority), with Financial Adviser (FA) concurrence if additional expenditure is involved.
The commercial contractor acting unilaterally in response to fluctuating local site contingencies.
The local statutory audit team reviewing procurement files during their periodic post-audit inspection.
questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 225(v) and (vi) of GFR 2017, no subordinate field authority (such as a Site Supervisor, Junior Engineer, or Storekeeper) or contractor is authorized to introduce material variations, alterations, or scope expansions into an executed public contract. Any amendment, variation order, or departure from the original contractual provisions can only be sanctioned by the Competent Financial Authority (CFA) that originally approved and accepted the contract, or by an authority superior to it. Furthermore, if such variations entail additional financial commitments or extra expenditure, the prior concurrence of the integrated Financial Adviser (FA) or Ministry of Finance is mandatory before issuing the formal amendment order.
questions.explanation_hindi: सामान्य वित्तीय नियमावली (GFR), 2017 के नियम 225(v) और (vi) तथा वित्तीय शक्तियों के प्रत्यायोजन नियमों (DFPR) के तहत, किसी भी अधीनस्थ क्षेत्रीय अधिकारी (जैसे कनिष्ठ अभियंता, साइट सुपरवाइजर) अथवा ठेकेदार को निष्पादित अनुबंध की शर्तों या कार्य के दायरे में सारभूत बदलाव करने का कोई अधिकार नहीं है। किसी भी अनुबंध संशोधन, विचलन आदेश (Variation Order) अथवा शर्तों में परिवर्तन को केवल वही सक्षम वित्तीय प्राधिकारी (CFA) स्वीकृत कर सकता है जिसने मूल रूप से अनुबंध को मंजूरी दी थी, अथवा उससे उच्चतर प्राधिकारी। इसके अतिरिक्त, यदि अनुबंध में बदलाव से कोई अतिरिक्त वित्तीय दायित्व या अतिरिक्त व्यय उत्पन्न होता है, तो औपचारिक आदेश जारी करने से पहले वित्तीय सलाहकार (FA) की पूर्व वित्तीय सहमति प्राप्त करना वैधानिक रूप से अनिवार्य है। अतः विकल्प B सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Only the original contract approving authority (or superior) with FA concurrence if extra expenditure occurs.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: authority (or superior) with FA concurrence if extra expenditure occurs. Material variations or scope modifications in an executed contract can be approved only by the authority that originally approved the contract, or a superior authority. questions.question_english: An audit team points out that the school has not recovered an overpayment of Rs. 15,000 made to a vendor last year. What is the most appropriate and legally sound course of action for the Principal?
options_english: Formally dispute the audit paragraph on grounds of administrative delay and take no further recovery action.
Accept the valid objection, initiate formal recovery proceedings against the vendor, and submit a compliance report to the audit team.
Immediately write off the unrecovered Rs. 15,000 as an unavoidable departmental operational loss without prior recovery efforts.
Deduct Rs. 15,000 proportionally from monthly salary disbursements of all school teaching staff.
questions.explanation_english: Under government financial rules and standard accounting propriety, when an audit inspection reveals an overpayment or erroneous disbursement of public funds to a contractor or supplier, the Head of Office / DDO is obligated to accept the valid objection and immediately initiate formal recovery proceedings against the concerned vendor. This involves issuing a formal demand notice, adjusting the excess sum against pending bills or security deposits, or taking legal recourse if necessary. Once the overpaid amount of Rs. 15,000 is recovered and credited back into the government treasury under the appropriate receipt head, an Action Taken Report (ATR) with challan details must be submitted to the audit authority to settle and drop the paragraph. A write-off can only be sought when recovery is genuinely impossible despite exhausting all legal avenues, and penalizing innocent staff is impermissible.
questions.explanation_hindi: सरकारी वित्तीय नियमों एवं वित्तीय औचित्य के सिद्धांतों के अनुसार, जब किसी ऑडिट निरीक्षण में विक्रेता को किए गए अधिक या गलत भुगतान (Overpayment) की पहचान होती है, तो कार्यालय प्रमुख/आहरण एवं संवितरण अधिकारी (DDO) का यह वैधानिक कर्तव्य है कि वह वैध आपत्ति को स्वीकार करे और विक्रेता से तत्काल वसूली की प्रक्रिया आरंभ करे। इसके लिए विक्रेता को मांग पत्र (Demand Notice) जारी किया जाता है अथवा उसके लंबित बिलों/सुरक्षा जमा से समायोजन किया जाता है। वसूली गई राशि को सरकारी खाते में जमा करने के उपरांत चालान प्रति के साथ अनुपालन रिपोर्ट (ATR) ऑडिट को भेजी जाती है ताकि आपत्ति का निस्तारण हो सके। बिना वसूली प्रयास के राशि को बट्टे खाते में डालना अथवा निर्दोष कर्मचारियों के वेतन से कटौती करना नियमों का गंभीर उल्लंघन है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (b) Accept objection, initiate recovery against vendor, and inform audit of compliance.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: vendor, and inform audit of compliance. When an audit inspection highlights an overpayment made to a supplier, the administrative head must accept the valid objection and immediately initiate formal recovery proceedings against the vendor. Once the excess amount is recovered and credited back to government accounts, the compliance report is forwarded to audit to settle the paragraph.

questions.question_english: A school Principal needs to procure a proprietary scientific apparatus that is manufactured exclusively by a single patent-holding firm. Under which specific provision of GFR 2017 is procurement from a single source permitted?

Rule 162 (Limited Tender Enquiry)
Rule 154 (Purchase of goods without quotation)
Rule 166 (Single Tender Enquiry)
questions.explanation_english: Rule 166 of GFR 2017 governs 'Single Tender Enquiry' (procurement from a single source). Procurement from a single source may be resorted to only under specific conditions: (i) It is in the knowledge of the user department that only a particular firm is the manufacturer of the required goods; (ii) In a case of emergency, the required goods are necessarily to be purchased from a particular source; or (iii) For standardization of machinery or spare parts to be compatible to the existing sets of equipments. When goods are proprietary to a single firm, the procuring official must record a mandatory 'Proprietary Article Certificate' (PAC) under Rule 166 before placing the order.
questions.explanation_hindi: GFR 2017 का नियम 166 'एकल निविदा जांच' (Single Tender Enquiry) का नियमन करता है। एकल स्रोत से खरीद केवल विशेष परिस्थितियों में ही की जा सकती है: (i) जब उपभोक्ता विभाग की जानकारी में यह हो कि केवल एक ही विशिष्ट फर्म अपेक्षित माल की एकमात्र निर्माता (sole manufacturer) है; (ii) आपातकालीन स्थिति में जब किसी विशिष्ट स्रोत से ही खरीद अनिवार्य हो; या (iii) विद्यमान मशीनों के मानकीकरण या स्पेयर पार्ट्स की अनुकूलता हेतु। इस नियम के तहत खरीद करने के लिए सक्षम प्राधिकारी को निर्धारित प्रारूप में 'स्वामित्व वस्तु प्रमाण पत्र' (Proprietary Article Certificate - PAC) दर्ज करना अनिवार्य होता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Rule 166 (Single Tender Enquiry)

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Rule 166 of the General Financial Rules governs procurement through Single Tender Enquiry, which is applicable when required goods are manufactured solely by a proprietary firm or in cases of extreme emergency. To utilize this provision for proprietary equipment, the competent authority must record a formal Proprietary Article Certificate confirming that no alternative or equivalent product is suitable.

questions.question_english: What is a primary technological feature of GeM designed to ensure competitiveness and fair pricing for high-value procurements?

Direct advance payments to preferred vendors
questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 149(iii) of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017, for procurements exceeding Rs. 5,00,000, buyers must mandatorily conduct online bidding or an electronic reverse auction on GeM. An electronic reverse auction (e-RA) is a dynamic online pricing mechanism where technically qualified sellers compete against each other in real-time during a scheduled electronic auction window, offering progressively lower prices. This transparent and automated competition prevents supplier collusion, removes human discretion or manual negotiations, and secures the most economical market prices for the government exchequer.
questions.explanation_hindi: सामान्य वित्तीय नियम (GFR), 2017 के नियम 149(iii) के अनुसार, ₹5,00,000 से अधिक की खरीद के लिए GeM पोर्टल पर ऑनलाइन बिडिंग या इलेक्ट्रॉनिक रिवर्स ऑक्शन (e-Reverse Auction) का उपयोग करना अनिवार्य है। ई-रिवर्स ऑक्शन एक गतिशील ऑनलाइन नीलामी प्रणाली है जिसमें तकनीकी रूप से योग्य विक्रेता एक निर्धारित समय-सीमा के दौरान वास्तविक समय (real-time) में एक-दूसरे के विरुद्ध प्रतिस्पर्धी बोलियां लगाते हुए अपने मूल्यों को घटाते हैं। यह स्वचालित और पारदर्शी तंत्र आपूर्तिकर्ताओं के गठजोड़ को समाप्त करता है, मानवीय बातचीत को रोकता है और सरकारी खजाने के लिए न्यूनतम और सर्वाधिक प्रतिस्पर्धी मूल्य सुनिश्चित करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) E-reverse auction

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: To maximize cost efficiency and foster dynamic competition for high-value procurements, the Government e-Marketplace incorporates an electronic reverse auction feature. This technology enables pre-qualified vendors to submit real-time, progressively lower price bids online during a specified timeframe, driving market prices down through automated transparent competition and delivering significant savings to the government treasury.

questions.explanation_english: Under GFR 2017 Rule 230(8) and Rule 238, grants-in-aid are sanctioned for specific, approved objects and schemes. questions.question_english: Which of the following statements correctly defines the scope of a "Subordinate Authority" under the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017?
options_english: A Head of Department operating under direct presidential authority without being subject to standard delegated rules
Non-gazetted administrative and ministerial support personnel (Group C and Group D) within a government office
Any department of the Central Government or any administrative authority exercising financial powers subordinate to the President
Commercial vendors and contractors registered under the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) system
questions.explanation_english:
Under Rule 2(xliii) of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017, "Subordinate Authority" is defined as a Department of the Central Government or any authority subordinate to the President of India.

Key administrative and statutory aspects include:
1. Delegation Framework: Under the Delegation of Financial Powers Rules (DFPR), 1978 and GFR 2017, the President delegates financial and sanctioning powers to various subordinate authorities, including Ministries, Departments, Heads of Departments (HoD), and Heads of Offices (HoO).
2. Application to School Principals: A Government School Principal functioning as Head of Office (HoO) and Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO) acts as a subordinate authority. The Principal exercises delegated sanctioning powers within prescribed monetary ceilings (e.g., for office contingencies, school repairs, and local purchases) strictly subordinate to the administrative Ministry/Directorate and the President.
3. Oversight and Accountability: All subordinate authorities are bound by the statutory limits of their financial delegation, budgetary appropriations, and the standards of financial propriety.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सामान्य वित्तीय नियम (GFR), 2017 के नियम 2(xliii) के अनुसार, "अधीनस्थ प्राधिकारी" (Subordinate Authority) का तात्पर्य केंद्र सरकार के किसी विभाग या भारत के राष्ट्रपति के अधीनस्थ किसी भी प्राधिकारी से है।

प्रमुख प्रशासनिक एवं वैधानिक बिंदु:
1. शक्तियों का प्रत्यायोजन: वित्तीय शक्तियों के प्रत्यायोजन नियम (DFPR), 1978 और GFR 2017 के अंतर्गत, राष्ट्रपति विभिन्न अधीनस्थ प्राधिकारियों—जैसे मंत्रालयों, विभागों, विभागाध्यक्षों (HoD) और कार्यालयाध्यक्षों (HoO)—को वित्तीय स्वीकृतियां जारी करने की शक्तियां सौंपते हैं।
2. विद्यालय प्राचार्य पर अनुप्रयोग: एक सरकारी विद्यालय के प्राचार्य, जो कार्यालयाध्यक्ष (HoO) और आहरण एवं संवितरण अधिकारी (DDO) के रूप में कार्य करते हैं, एक अधीनस्थ प्राधिकारी के रूप में कार्य करते हैं। प्राचार्य को निर्धारित वित्तीय सीमाओं (जैसे आकस्मिक व्यय, विद्यालय मरम्मत और स्थानीय खरीद) के भीतर वित्तीय स्वीकृतियां देने का अधिकार प्राप्त होता है, जो निदेशालय और राष्ट्रपति के अधीनस्थ होता है।
3. जवाबदेही और सीमाएं: सभी अधीनस्थ प्राधिकारी अपने प्रत्यायोजन आदेशों, बजटीय सीमाओं और वित्तीय औचित्य के नियमों से पूरी तरह बंधे होते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) It includes any authority delegated financial powers subordinate to the President.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: powers subordinate to the President. In administrative and financial terminology, a subordinate authority refers to any officer, administrative body, or organizational head that exercises delegated financial powers subordinate to the President of India. These authorities function within established financial hierarchies, deriving their sanctioning powers from formal delegation rules while remaining subject to oversight, budget limitations, and supervisory control by superior administrative bodies and financial officers.

questions.question_english: A school Principal holds a sanctioned permanent advance (imprest) of Rs. 5,000. During a month, the Principal incurs legitimate office expenditures totaling Rs. 4,500 on urgent postal dispatches, minor plumbing repairs, and laboratory cartage. What is the correct procedural action the Principal must take next?
options_english: Submit an imprest recoupment bill along with verified sub-vouchers for Rs. 4,500 to the accounts officer to restore the cash balance.
Close the permanent advance account immediately and suspend all petty contingent expenditures until the next financial year.
Deduct Rs. 4,500 proportionately from the monthly salaries of subordinate office staff to replenish the fund.
Request the School Management Committee (SMC) members to collect voluntary cash donations of Rs. 4,500 from parents.
questions.explanation_english:
Under Rule 322 of GFR 2017 and Government Accounting Rules:
1. Operating Mechanism of Permanent Advance: The permanent advance operates as a revolving imprest. The sum of physical cash in the office safe plus unrecouped paid sub-vouchers must at all times equal the total sanctioned advance limit:
   Sanctioned Advance (Rs. 5,000) = Cash Balance (Rs. 500) + Paid Sub-vouchers (Rs. 4,500).
2. Recoupment Process: To restore the liquid cash balance back to Rs. 5,000, the Principal / Head of Office prepares an Imprest Recoupment Bill on the standard contingent bill format, attaches the original stamped sub-vouchers duly cancelled with "Paid and Cancelled", certifies the payments, and submits it to the Pay and Accounts Office (PAO).
3. Re-crediting: Upon audit and sanction, the accounts officer issues a cheque / electronic credit for Rs. 4,500, replenishing the school's petty cash balance back to Rs. 5,000.
4. Prohibited actions: Freezing administrative functions, deducting from staff salaries, or seeking private donations are illegal, unethical, and represent gross violations of financial rules.
Therefore, Option A is the correct procedural action.
questions.explanation_hindi:
जीएफआर 2017 के नियम 322 और सरकारी लेखा नियमों के अनुसार:
1. स्थायी अग्रिम की कार्यप्रणाली: स्थायी अग्रिम एक परिक्रामी इम्प्रेस्ट के रूप में संचालित होता है। कार्यालय की तिजोरी में उपलब्ध भौतिक नकदी और प्रतिपूर्ति हेतु लंबित भुगतान किए गए उप-वाउचरों का योग हमेशा कुल स्वीकृत अग्रिम सीमा के बराबर होना चाहिए:
   स्वीकृत अग्रिम (₹5,000) = नकद शेष (₹500) + भुगतान किए गए उप-वाउचर (₹4,500)।
2. प्रतिपूर्ति प्रक्रिया (Recoupment): नकद शेष को पुनः ₹5,000 तक लाने के लिए, प्राचार्य/कार्यालय प्रमुख मानक आकस्मिक बिल प्रारूप पर एक 'इम्प्रेस्ट प्रतिपूर्ति बिल' तैयार करते हैं, "भुगतान किया गया और रद्द किया गया" (Paid and Cancelled) मोहर लगे मूल उप-वाउचर संलग्न करते हैं, खर्च को प्रमाणित करते हैं और इसे वेतन एवं लेखा कार्यालय (PAO) को प्रस्तुत करते हैं।
3. पुनर्भरण: लेखा परीक्षा और पास आदेश के बाद, लेखा अधिकारी ₹4,500 का इलेक्ट्रॉनिक भुगतान जारी करता है, जिससे विद्यालय की खुदरा नकदी वापस पूरी ₹5,000 हो जाती है।
4. प्रतिबंधित कार्य: प्रशासनिक कार्यों को रोकना, कर्मचारियों के वेतन से कटौती करना, या निजी दान मांगना पूर्णतः अवैध और वित्तीय नियमों का गंभीर उल्लंघन है।
अतः विकल्प A सही प्रक्रियात्मक कार्रवाई है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Submit an imprest recoupment bill with vouchers for Rs. 4,500 to restore balance.

questions.explanation_english: Rule 33(1) of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017 mandates that any loss or shortage of public moneys, departmental revenue or receipts, stamps, stores, or other property held by or on behalf of Government caused by defalcation or otherwise, which comes to the notice of an officer, shall immediately be reported by him to the next higher administrative authority, as well as to the Statutory Audit Officer and to the Principal Accounts Officer. questions.question_english:
Arrange the typical procedure for handling a significant financial loss (e.g., embezzlement by a cashier) in the correct sequential order:
I. Issuance of final write-off order by the competent authority if recovery is impossible.
II. Preliminary report to higher authority and police (FIR).
III. Detailed departmental inquiry to fix responsibility.
IV. Attempt to recover the loss from the responsible official.
options_english: II, III, IV, I
III, II, I, IV
II, IV, III, I
IV, III, II, I
questions.explanation_english: Handling serious financial defalcation or embezzlement follows a well-defined statutory procedure under Rules 33, 34, and 37 of GFR 2017: First, the establishment head must immediately submit a preliminary loss report to higher administrative authorities, Statutory Audit, and the Accounts Officer, and simultaneously lodge an FIR with the local police (II). Second, a detailed departmental inquiry must be instituted to uncover the modus operandi, identify internal control failures, and fix personal responsibility (III). Third, disciplinary proceedings are executed to formally recover the embezzled sum from the responsible official's pay, allowances, terminal gratuity, or attached personal assets (IV). Fourth, only if recovery of the entire or partial amount proves completely impossible despite all administrative and legal efforts, the remaining balance is submitted to the competent authority for formal write-off sanction under DFPR (I). Thus, the correct sequence is II -> III -> IV -> I.
questions.explanation_hindi: जीएफआर 2017 के नियम 33, 34 और 37 के अनुसार गंभीर वित्तीय गबन अथवा धोखाधड़ी के मामलों में कार्रवाई का निश्चित क्रम इस प्रकार है: सबसे पहले, गबन का पता चलने पर कार्यालय प्रमुख द्वारा उच्चाधिकारियों, सांविधिक ऑडिट एवं लेखा अधिकारी को प्रारंभिक रिपोर्ट भेजना तथा स्थानीय पुलिस में प्राथमिकी (FIR) दर्ज कराना (II)। दूसरा, गबन की कार्यप्रणाली, व्यवस्थागत विफलताओं की जांच तथा व्यक्तिगत उत्तरदायित्व निर्धारित करने हेतु विस्तृत विभागीय जांच आयोजित करना (III)। तीसरा, अनुशासनात्मक कार्रवाई के माध्यम से दोषी अधिकारी के वेतन, भत्तों, ग्रेच्युटी अथवा संपत्ति से गबन की गई राशि की वसूली के समस्त प्रयास करना (IV)। चौथा, यदि सभी विधिक एवं प्रशासनिक प्रयासों के बावजूद राशि की वसूली पूर्णतः असंभव सिद्ध हो, तब सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा बट्टे खाते में डालने (Write-off) का औपचारिक आदेश जारी करना (I)। अतः सही क्रम II -> III -> IV -> I है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (a) II, III, IV, I

The department then attempts formal recovery from the responsible employee. If recovery proves impossible, a formal write-off order is issued.

questions.question_english: In government financial administration and accounting, what is the fundamental difference between "Pre-audit" and "Post-audit"?
options_english: Pre-audit involves preliminary review by internal school management, while post-audit is conducted by external student bodies.
Pre-audit is conducted exclusively by the CAG, while post-audit is conducted by the departmental Pay and Accounts Office.
Pre-audit applies strictly to non-consumable store purchases, while post-audit applies exclusively to consumable items.
Pre-audit checks claims and bills before payment is released; post-audit reviews transactions after disbursement has occurred.
questions.explanation_english: In public financial management, 'Pre-audit' (or pre-check) is the process of examining, verifying, and validating bills, vouchers, expenditure sanctions, budget appropriations, and statutory compliances before a payment is actually disbursed by the Treasury or the Pay and Accounts Office (PAO). It acts as a preventive financial control ensuring that unauthorized, incorrect, or fraudulent claims are intercepted before public funds leave the government account. Conversely, 'Post-audit' refers to the retrospective examination of financial records, accounting entries, and paid vouchers conducted after disbursement has taken place. Post-audit is performed periodically by internal audit parties and external statutory auditors (CAG) to assess accounting integrity, regularity, economy, efficiency, and financial propriety.
questions.explanation_hindi: सार्वजनिक वित्तीय प्रबंधन में 'पूर्व-लेखापरीक्षा' (Pre-audit / Pre-check) से तात्पर्य राजकोष अथवा वेतन एवं लेखा कार्यालय (PAO) द्वारा वास्तविक भुगतान जारी करने से पूर्व बिलों, वाउचरों, वित्तीय स्वीकृतियों, बजट प्रावधानों और नियमों के अनुपालन की जांच व सत्यापन से है। यह एक निवारक (preventive) वित्तीय नियंत्रण है जिसका उद्देश्य किसी भी अनधिकृत या त्रुटिपूर्ण भुगतान को रोकना है। इसके विपरीत, 'पश्चात-लेखापरीक्षा' (Post-audit) भुगतान या संवितरण संपन्न हो जाने के बाद खातों, भुगतान किए गए वाउचरों और संबंधित अभिलेखों की पूर्वव्यापी (retrospective) जांच है। यह आंतरिक लेखापरीक्षा दलों तथा सांविधिक लेखापरीक्षकों (CAG) द्वारा यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए की जाती है कि वित्तीय नियमों, औचित्य और प्रक्रियाओं का समुचित पालन हुआ है अथवा नहीं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (d) Pre-audit checks claims before payment; post-audit reviews transactions after disbursement.

questions.question_hindi: GFR 2017 के अंतर्गत सार्वजनिक खरीद के मूलभूत सिद्धांतों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा युग्म गलत है?

questions.question_english: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECT regarding the fundamental principles of public procurement under GFR 2017?
options_english: Economy - Procuring required goods and services of requisite quality at the most competitive and reasonable market price
Efficiency - Ensuring timely completion of procurement workflows while strictly avoiding procedural and administrative delays
Equality - Reserving all government supply contracts exclusively for large multinational corporations
Transparency - Maintaining an open, competitive, and publicly accessible bidding process with clear specifications
questions.explanation_english: Rule 144 of GFR 2017 establishes the fundamental principles of public buying: Economy, Efficiency, Effectiveness, Equity (Equality/Fairness), and Transparency. The principle of 'Equality' (or Fair Treatment) dictates that every eligible vendor must receive equal opportunity and unbiased treatment without arbitrary discrimination or preferential bias. Restricting procurement contracts solely to large multinational corporations is a flagrant violation of this principle. Furthermore, government procurement frameworks such as the Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) Order, 2012 and the 'Make in India' (Preference to Make in India) Order actively mandate reservation and purchase preferences for domestic MSMEs and local suppliers to promote inclusive industrial growth, completely contradicting the idea of exclusivity for multinational corporations.
questions.explanation_hindi: GFR 2017 का नियम 144 सार्वजनिक खरीद के मूल सिद्धांतों (मितव्ययिता, दक्षता, प्रभावशीलता, निष्पक्षता/समानता और पारदर्शिता) को प्रतिपादित करता है। 'समानता और निष्पक्षता' (Equality and Fairness) के सिद्धांत का अर्थ है कि सभी पात्र आपूर्तिकर्ताओं और बोलीदाताओं को बिना किसी भेदभाव के समान अवसर प्राप्त हो। सरकारी अनुबंधों को केवल बड़ी बहुराष्ट्रीय कंपनियों के लिए आरक्षित करना इस सिद्धांत का प्रत्यक्ष उल्लंघन है। इसके विपरीत, सरकार की सूक्ष्म और लघु उद्यम (MSE) खरीद नीति तथा 'मेक इन इंडिया' नीति के तहत स्थानीय सूक्ष्म, लघु और मध्यम उद्यमों (MSMEs) को प्राथमिकता एवं आरक्षण दिया जाता है, न कि बहुराष्ट्रीय कंपनियों का एकाधिकार स्थापित किया जाता है।

questions.explanation_english:
Rule 21 of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017 explicitly lays down the "Standards of Financial Propriety" (often referred to as the Canons of Financial Propriety) that every public officer managing government funds must strictly observe.

Overview of the Rule:
1. Rule 21 serves as the ethical and legal foundation of public expenditure in India. It mandates that public money must be spent with ordinary prudence, without extravagance, without personal conflict of interest, and not for the exclusive benefit of individuals or groups unless legally backed.
2. Comparison with other cited rules:
   - Rule 11: Governs the collection and receipt of government revenues and dues.
   - Rule 144: Lays down the fundamental principles of public buying and procurement of goods.
   - Rule 225: Pertains to general principles governing Grants-in-Aid to non-governmental bodies.
   - Rule 21: Specifically codifies the Standards of Financial Propriety.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सामान्य वित्तीय नियम (GFR), 2017 का नियम 21 स्पष्ट रूप से "वित्तीय औचित्य के मानक" (Standards of Financial Propriety) को निर्धारित करता है, जिसे प्रत्येक सरकारी अधिकारी द्वारा सार्वजनिक धन का प्रबंधन करते समय अनिवार्य रूप से देखा जाना चाहिए।

नियम का संक्षिप्त विश्लेषण:
1. नियम 21 भारत में सार्वजनिक व्यय का नैतिक और कानूनी आधार है। यह अधिदेशित करता है कि सरकारी धन को सामान्य विवेक, मितव्ययिता, बिना किसी व्यक्तिगत स्वार्थ/हितों के टकराव के खर्च किया जाए।
2. अन्य संदर्भित नियमों की स्थिति:
   - नियम 11: सरकारी राजस्व और बकाए की प्राप्ति एवं संग्रहण से संबंधित है।
   - नियम 144: वस्तुओं की सार्वजनिक खरीद के मौलिक सिद्धांतों को निर्धारित करता है।
   - नियम 225: गैर-सरकारी संस्थाओं को दिए जाने वाले सहायता अनुदान (Grants-in-Aid) के सामान्य सिद्धांतों से संबंधित है।
   - नियम 21: विशेष रूप से वित्तीय औचित्य के मानकों को संहिताबद्ध करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Rule 21

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Rule 21 of the General Financial Rules 2017 details the fundamental standards of financial propriety that every public official must observe. These standards act as statutory moral and administrative guidelines, mandating that officers manage public money with high integrity, enforce strict economy, avoid conflicts of interest, and ensure expenditure does not exceed reasonable necessity for the occasion being funded.
